THE ATTENTION EXPERIMENT

He used to like fruit.

The screen is connected to a local fly-network simulation. Its pixels drive the model’s visual inputs. Stimulating PAM11 cells can modify an experimental memory rule on existing synapses.

Drag to look around the chamber. Swipe, scroll, or press ↓ to change the short. Press Space to pause. Stimulate PAM11 to make a questionable situation worse.

The local Python/C++ engine integrates 166,700 neurons and 25.6 million connections from MaleCNS v1.0, with simplified spiking dynamics. Screen pixels drive 4,146 mapped visual inputs. PAM11 stimulation targets 15 annotated dopamine cells; the interface shows their measured firing rates, not dopamine concentration. Feed playback uses wall time; each accepted frame advances a fixed interval of neural time, shown separately. The fly’s movements are artistic mappings of recorded activity. The model does not measure attention, pleasure, consciousness, addiction, or proven learning.
Inspired by nftechie’s stonkfly ↗
